description: Arceaux de stationnement vélo - Angers is a dataset listed in Angers Loire Métropole - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Angers Loire Métropole. Localisation et nombre par regroupement de stationnement vélo. Description des principaux champs du jeu de données: [NOM ]: nom de l’objet géographique [ARCNB]: nombre d’arceaux vélos sur le site [LIBVOI]: libellé de la voie [DATEMAJ]: date de mise à jour de la donnée [SOURCE]: source de la donnée Les objets géographiques ont été numérisés sur ... Coverage: Angers Loire Métropole. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are vélo, Catalogue SIG. The portal shows 1,099 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-angers-fr-portal.
